title: Finding
description: Finding dengan lifecycle (ROADMAP 26) dan novelty classification (ROADMAP 28). Finding tidak boleh 'confirmed' hanya berdasarkan satu indikasi — minimum evidence: baseline, reproduction steps, expected/actual behavior, impact, false-positive analysis, scope reference, confidence, sanitized artifact (ROADMAP 25). Payload success != vulnerability confirmation (ROADMAP 22).

state.description: Lifecycle finding (ROADMAP 26): observation -> hypothesis -> suspected -> needs-validation -> reproduced -> confirmed; alternative: duplicate, rejected, inconclusive.

hypothesis.description: Hypothesis keamanan yang diuji (dibuat Hermes, ROADMAP 1, 26).

baseline_evidence_ref.description: Referensi ID evidence baseline (kondisi normal) — minimum evidence untuk finding (ROADMAP 25, schemas/evidence.schema.json).

reproduction_steps.description: Langkah reproduksi secara berurutan; wajib untuk finding confirmed (ROADMAP 25, 46).

false_positive_analysis.description: Analisis false positive — wajib untuk setiap finding (ROADMAP 46).

scope_ref.description: Referensi ke scope/authorization engagement yang mengizinkan pengujian ini (ROADMAP 8, 25).

sanitized_artifacts.description: Daftar path artifact yang SUDAH disanitasi terhadap credential aktif sebelum dipersist (ROADMAP 23, 25).

novelty_classification.description: Klasifikasi novelty (ROADMAP 28). Project tidak boleh otomatis menyatakan zero-day: potentially novel high-impact -> stop active testing, simpan evidence minimum, redact, mark potentially-unknown, inform user, human decides.

then.description: Finding 'confirmed' wajib memenuhi minimum evidence ROADMAP 25: baseline + reproduction + expected/actual behavior + impact + false-positive analysis + scope reference + confidence + sanitized artifact.
Finding duplicate/rejected/inconclusive wajib menjelaskan alasannya melalui false_positive_analysis (ROADMAP 26).
